START_TEXT: Hi! Send me an invoice and I'll extract its details.
HELP_TEXT:
Use the buttons below for quick actions.
Other commands: /show, /edit, /edititem, /comment, /save, /invoices.
UPLOAD_PROMPT: Send a PDF or a photo of an invoice. I'll extract its details and show you a draft.
OCR_EMPTY_RESULT: No invoice details were found. Try another file or photo.
OCR_UNAVAILABLE: Invoice recognition is unavailable. Try again later.
FILE_PROCESSING_FAILED_WITH_FORMATS: Could not process the file. Try a PDF, JPG, or PNG.
FILE_PROCESSING_FAILED: Could not process the file. Try a different format.
DRAFT_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the draft. Try again later.
TABLE_TOO_LONG_SEND_CSV: The table is too long to display here. I'll send it as a CSV file.
OCR_REVIEW_REASON_TOTAL_MISMATCH: the line total differs from quantity × unit price after the discount
OCR_REVIEW_REASON_TOTAL_COMPUTED: the line total was calculated from quantity and unit price
OCR_REVIEW_REASON_QTY_COMPUTED: the quantity was calculated from line total and unit price
OCR_REVIEW_REASON_PRICE_COMPUTED: the unit price was calculated from line total and quantity
OCR_REVIEW_REASON_QTY_CORRECTED: the decimal separator was restored in the quantity
OCR_REVIEW_REASON_TOTAL_CORRECTED: the decimal separator was restored in the line total
OCR_REVIEW_ROWS_SKIPPED: Rows left out of the draft because they could not be read: {count}.
NO_DRAFT_UPLOAD_DOCUMENT: You have no draft. Upload an invoice to start one.
NO_DRAFT_SEND_DOCUMENT: You have no draft. Send an invoice to start one.
COMMENT_ADDED_SAVE_HINT: Comment added. Use /save to save the draft.
COMMENT_PROMPT: Enter a comment for this invoice:
FIELD_UPDATED: Field updated. Tap Save or use /save to save the draft.
TOTAL_UPDATED: Total updated. Tap Save or use /save to save the draft.
TOTAL_UPDATED_AS_TEXT: The total was updated as text.
ITEM_UPDATED: Line item updated. Tap Save or use /save to save the draft.
HEADER_UPDATED: Invoice details updated. Use /show to review or /save to save the draft.
LINE_UPDATED: Line item updated. Use /show to review or /save to save the draft.
INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE: That line item number is out of range.
NOT_A_NUMBER_RETRY: Enter a number and try again.
EDIT_USAGE: Usage: /edit supplier=...; client=...; date=YYYY-MM-DD; doc=...; total=123.45
INVOICES_TOO_MANY_LINES: Too many results. Narrow your filters and try again.
PERIOD_SUPPLIER_PROMPT: Enter a supplier name or part of it. Type “-” to skip:
PERIOD_DATES_MISSING: The dates are missing. Enter the date range again.
AUTO_SUM_MISMATCH_COMMENT: [auto] Total mismatch: line items {sum_items:.2f}, invoice total {header_sum:.2f}, difference {diff:+.2f}. Invoice: {doc_number}, supplier: {supplier}.
EDIT_ENTER_ITEM_VALUE: Enter a new value for “{field_label}” on line #{idx}:
EDIT_SELECT_ITEM: Choose a line item to edit (total: {total_count}):
